## EXIT BAR MET — the DC harness is GREEN end to end (run 30964805133)

The operator-approved 14th criterion is satisfied. Harness run **30964805133** at `c3fb869ab5`,
`jira DC harness smoke (real Jira Data Center, ephemeral)`, 42m39s:

    62 passed, 1 xfailed in 2559.32s
    [jira-live-canary] collected=63 executed=62 skipped=1

**Zero failures, and nothing silently dropped** — the canary reconciles collected vs executed, so a
quietly-skipped cell cannot hide behind a green job. (The one `skipped=1` IS the xfail.)

### The three cells that had NEVER passed now pass

Across the twelve harness runs from 30834117797 (08-03 16:52) to 30951453979 (08-04 21:14),
`inbound_set_subtask_parent`, `outbound_set_subtask_parent` and `outbound_clear_parent` failed
**12/12**. They are green for the first time, via the operator-approved re-home:

    test_inbound_set_parent_round_trips                                  PASSED
    test_outbound_unrepresentable_parent_is_REPORTED_rather_than_silently_dropped  PASSED
    test_a_subtask_reparent_is_REFUSED_rather_than_silently_ignored      PASSED
    test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips                              PASSED
    test_outbound_epic_parent_reaches_dc_THROUGH_A_RECONCILE_PASS        PASSED
    test_a_repeat_pass_over_a_converged_epic_parent_plans_nothing        PASSED

**The hard constraint was honoured — verified, not assumed.** No cell was deleted, skipped or
`xfail`ed to reach green: neither commit adds a `skip`/`xfail` to a live cell; 4b9e removed no test
function at all (it rewrote `outbound_clear_parent` in place); and 9f26's two `-def` removals are
RENAMES — the sub-task-specific names gave way to the re-homed cells above, plus a new 392-line unit
module pinning that the emit suppression is loud.

### Why this is a real fix and not a re-labelling

* `test_outbound_epic_parent_reaches_dc_THROUGH_A_RECONCILE_PASS` closes
  [rebar:39c1-2a32-b564-4b4b]'s disjoint-gates gap END TO END: the apply side wanted a sub-task child,
  the emit side only emitted for epic parents, so no reconcile pass could carry a parent-set on DC at
  all. It now can, asserted through a real pass rather than at unit level.
* `test_a_repeat_pass_over_a_converged_epic_parent_plans_nothing` proves convergence, not churn.
* `test_a_subtask_reparent_is_REFUSED_rather_than_silently_ignored` fixes the actual user-visible
  defect from [rebar:1a9f-50c0-e7a5-4fda]: DC accepts `PUT fields.parent` on a sub-task with HTTP 204
  and IGNORES it, so rebar reported success while the user's hierarchy change was lost. It now
  refuses loudly. Re-measured live this session (run 30951453979) rather than inherited from the
  capability map.

### Why the criterion existed

The other 13 criteria were ALL met while three live cells failed, because none of them required the
harness to pass — criterion-completeness was not evidence the feature worked. That gap is now closed
by construction.

**Remaining before this epic can close:** [rebar:9f26-66c2-14af-4223], [rebar:4b9e-bcad-456a-4233],
[rebar:8390-...], [rebar:34c2-...] and [rebar:9790-cafa-dffa-462e]. The epic's own plan-review
attestation is `stale-material` from this edit and needs a fresh `review-plan` before close.
